question: Who transmitted the teaching concerning the auspicious-feeding earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: The teaching concerning the auspicious-feeding earth-movers was told by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The meaning of subhakṣāṇāṃ in this ritual context is uncertain
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the auspicious-feeding earth-movers by an earth-mover.
